Provider profile: Bayside Imaging - imaging (MRI, CT, ultrasound), 2 miles from the practice. In network: Harbor Health PPO, Cedar Mutual, Medicare. Intake rule: MRI referrals need the clinical notes and a copy of the insurance card attached, or the referral is returned.
Provider profile: Northgate Imaging - imaging (MRI, CT), 11 miles from the practice. In network: Harbor Health PPO, Medicare. Pulls clinical notes itself through the shared records portal.
Provider profile: Lakeview Dermatology - dermatology, 3 miles from the practice. In network: Harbor Health PPO, Cedar Mutual, Medicare.
Provider profile: Pinecrest Dermatology - dermatology, 7 miles from the practice. In network: Harbor Health PPO, Cedar Mutual.

Provider profile: Summit Heart Clinic - cardiology (echocardiograms, stress tests, consults), 4 miles from the practice. In network: Harbor Health PPO, Cedar Mutual, Medicare. Intake rule: echocardiogram orders must be signed by the referring clinician and come with the most recent ECG.
Provider profile: Riverside Cardiology - cardiology (echocardiograms, consults), 9 miles from the practice. In network: Harbor Health PPO, Medicare.
Office notes (Dana Whitlock): Bayside Imaging is slow for MRI (spine, knee, shoulder) - a referral takes about two weeks to get scanned. Send MRIs to Northgate Imaging instead (about 6 days).
Office notes (Dana Whitlock): Lakeview Dermatology is slow - about a month from referral to visit. If the patient can't wait that long, use Pinecrest Dermatology (about 9 days).
Office notes (Dana Whitlock): Summit Heart Clinic is slow for echocardiograms - often 11 days or more. Riverside Cardiology gets patients in faster (about 8 days).
